requirements.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirements.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirements.activationStatus: Evidence-only - physical result not inferred by SHACL
requirements.verifiedSourceText: Mandatory communication equipment for use in survival craft, including liferafts and rescue boats, shall be capable of operation during the maximum expected time of rescue.
requirements.normalizedRequirement: Every mandatory survival-craft communication device shall have demonstrated_operating_duration_days >= maximum_expected_rescue_time_days AND duration_test_status = passed.

requirements.source: Polar Code January 2026 Supplement - Resolution MSC.538(107)
requirements.verifiedSourceText: Ice-strengthened ships constructed on or after 1 January 2026 shall have either two independent echo-sounding devices or one echo-sounding device with two separate independent transducers. Other devices capable of depth sounding, such as fish finders, acceptable to the Administration, may be used as equivalent means of meeting this requirement.
requirements.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_ice_strengthened = true AND construction_date >= '2026-01-01', THEN independent_echo_sounding_device_count >= 2 OR (echo_sounding_device_count >= 1 AND independent_transducer_count >= 2) OR administration_approved_equivalent_depth_sounding_device_present = true.

requirements.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirements.verifiedSourceText: The ship shall always be loaded down at least to the draught of LIWL amidships when navigating in ice. Any ballast tank, situated above the LIWL and needed to load down the ship to this water line, shall be equipped with devices to prevent the water from freezing. In determining the LIWL, regard shall be paid to the need to ensure a reasonable degree of ice-going capability in ballast. The highest point of the propeller shall be submerged and if possible at a depth of at least h_i below the water surface in all loading conditions. The forward draught shall be at least (2 + 0.00025*Delta)*h_i [m], but need not exceed 4*h_i (2.1), where Delta is the displacement of the ship [t] determined from the waterline on the UIWL (see section 2.1). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the displacement must be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest displacement. h_i is the level ice thickness [m] according to section 4.2.1.
requirements.normalizedRequirement: When navigating in ice, draught_amidships_m >= LIWL_draught_amidships_m. Any ballast tank above LIWL that is needed to reach LIWL shall have freezing_prevention_present = true. propeller_highest_point_submerged = true. forward_draught_m >= min((2 + 0.00025*displacement_UIWL_t)*level_ice_thickness_m, 4*level_ice_thickness_m). If multiple UIWL waterlines exist, use the displacement at the greatest-displacement UIWL.
